prompt: The attached image is a 240x294 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Golden character</title>
<style>
html,body{width:240px;height:294px;margin:0;overflow:hidden}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:294px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true,antialias:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,294);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const backdrop = document.createElement('canvas');
backdrop.width =  forty();
backdrop.height = 48;
function forty(){return 40;}
const ctx = backdrop.getContext('2d');
const bg = ctx.createImageData(40,48);
const stops = [[0,[210,207,199]],[.14,[227,228,224]],[.34,[250,250,247]],[.63,[255,255,253]],[.77,[244,245,240]],[1,[171,170,166]]];
for(let j=0;j<48;j++){
  const y=j/47;
  let k=1;
  while(y>stops[k][0]) k++;
  const blend=(y-stops[k-1][0])/(stops[k][0]-stops[k-1][0]);
  for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
    const x=i/39;
    const leftGlow=5*Math.exp(-((x-.08)**2/.028+(y-.51)**2/.10));
    const corner=4*x*Math.cos(y*6);
    for(let c=0;c<3;c++) bg.data[4*(j*40+i)+c]=stops[k-1][1][c]*(1-blend)+stops[k][1][c]*blend+leftGlow-corner;
    bg.data[4*(j*40+i)+3]=255;
  }
}
ctx.putImageData(bg,0,0);
const background = new THREE.CanvasTexture(backdrop);
background.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
scene.background = background;

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-2.4,2.4,2.94,-2.94,.1,60);
ref.position.set(0,2.94,14);
ref.lookAt(0,2.94,0);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffcf0,0xc0aa82,1.55));
function light(color,intensity,x,y,z){
  const lamp=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,intensity);
  lamp.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(lamp);
}
light(0xfff8e7,1.85,-4,8,5);
light(0xfff6db,.55,3,5,-4);
light(0xffffff,.23,4,1,4);

function group(parent,name,x=0,y=0,z=0){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  g.position.set(x,y,z);
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
const character=group(scene,'character-golden',-.38,0,0);
const colors = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.96});
const color = hex => new THREE.Color(hex);
const mix = THREE.MathUtils.lerp;
const sm = THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep;
const gold = color(0xc69b39);
const shadeGold = color(0xad7633);
const highGold = color(0xdac04e);
const bellyIvory = color(0xe8d4a0);
const ochre = color(0xc08e40);
const charcoal = color(0x494131);
const fingertip = color(0x352e22);

function profile(parent,name,rows,paint){
  const rail=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(rows.map(r=>new THREE.Vector3(r[1],r[0],r[2])),false,'catmullrom',.43);
  const axis=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(rows.map(r=>new THREE.Vector3(r[3]||0,r[0],r[4]||0)),false,'catmullrom',.43);
  const pos=[],rgb=[],idx=[];
  const bands=92, sides=80;
  for(let j=0;j<=bands;j++){
    const t=j/bands, p=rail.getPoint(t), o=axis.getPoint(t);
    for(let i=0;i<=sides;i++){
      const a=(i%sides)/sides*Math.PI*2;
      const s=Math.sin(a), f=Math.cos(a);
      const x=o.x+s*Math.max(.001,p.x), z=o.z+f*Math.max(.001,p.z);
      pos.push(x,p.y,z);
      const c=paint(x,p.y,z,s,f);
      rgb.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      if(i<sides&&j<bands){
        const n=j*(sides+1)+i;
        idx.push(n,n+1,n+sides+1,n+1,n+sides+2,n+sides+1);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(rgb,3));
  geo.setIndex(idx);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const normals=geo.attributes.normal;
  for(let j=0;j<=bands;j++){
    const a=j*(sides+1),b=a+sides;
    const n=new THREE.Vector3(normals.getX(a)+normals.getX(b),normals.getY(a)+normals.getY(b),normals.getZ(a)+normals.getZ(b)).normalize();
    normals.setXYZ(a,n.x,n.y,n.z);
    normals.setXYZ(b,n.x,n.y,n.z);
  }
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,colors);
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
}

const torso=group(character,'torso');
profile(torso,'rounded body',[
  [1.35,.01,.01,-.01,0],[1.44,.44,.30,-.02,0],[1.68,.75,.48,-.025,.015],
  [2.00,.96,.66,-.015,.03],[2.39,1.12,.80,.005,.055],
  [2.76,1.14,.83,.012,.065],[3.14,1.065,.76,.006,.064],
  [3.48,.956,.63,-.015,.05],[3.81,.887,.51,-.055,.005],
  [4.15,.843,.445,-.068,-.04],[4.44,.715,.385,-.064,-.045],
  [4.72,.565,.33,-.049,-.05],[4.97,.412,.27,-.021,-.05],
  [5.16,.325,.25,-.012,-.04],[5.23,.01,.01,-.012,-.04]
],(x,y,z,s,f)=>{
  const c=shadeGold.clone().lerp(gold,sm(y,1.4,3.2)).lerp(highGold,sm(y,3.52,4.66)*.78);
  const patch=Math.sqrt(((x-.035)/1.08)**2+((y-3.03)/1.00)**2);
  const mask=(1-sm(patch,.81,1.05))*sm(f,-.02,.56);
  const cream=ochre.clone().lerp(bellyIvory,sm(y,2.13,3.57));
  return c.lerp(cream,mask);
});

for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const leg=group(character,side<0?'leg-left':'leg-right',side*.355,1.73,-.035);
  profile(leg,'tapered leg',[
    [-2.11,.01,.01,-side*.079,.12],[-2.06,.198,.28,-side*.079,.105],
    [-1.92,.203,.28,-side*.073,.095],[-1.74,.218,.204,-side*.065,.015],
    [-1.36,.245,.222,-side*.033,0],[-.95,.283,.267,-side*.011,0],
    [-.54,.337,.323,side*.01,.005],[-.14,.396,.391,side*.006,.018],
    [.16,.321,.31,0,.016],[.24,.01,.01,0,0]
  ],(x,y,z,s,f)=>shadeGold.clone().lerp(ochre,sm(y,-1.9,.1)*.8).multiplyScalar(.87+.13*sm(s*side,-1,1)));
}

const head=group(character,'head',-.005,4.72,-.014);
profile(head,'rounded head',[
  [-.23,.02,.02,0,-.01],[-.16,.425,.303,0,-.013],
  [.03,.47,.357,.004,.005],[.25,.453,.366,.008,.011],
  [.45,.417,.339,.005,.008],[.617,.345,.284,-.003,-.008],
  [.735,.22,.192,-.014,-.014],[.802,.085,.081,-.02,-.021],
  [.82,.001,.001,-.022,-.023]
],(x,y,z,s,f)=>{
  const c=gold.clone().lerp(highGold,sm(y,.03,.69));
  const warmth=Math.exp(-((x/.34)**2+((y-.16)/.26)**2))*sm(f,0,.85);
  return c.lerp(color(0xb68841),warmth*.67);
});

function sweep(parent,name,knots,paint,steps=36,sides=16){
  const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(knots.map(k=>new THREE.Vector3(k[0],k[1],k[2])),false,'catmullrom',.44);
  const pos=[],rgb=[],indices=[];
  for(let j=0;j<=steps;j++){
    const t=j/steps,u=t*(knots.length-1),k=Math.min(Math.floor(u),knots.length-2);
    const p=curve.getPoint(t), d=curve.getTangent(t).normalize();
    const n=new THREE.Vector3(d.y,-d.x,0);
    if(n.lengthSq()<.001)n.set(1,0,0);
    n.normalize();
    const b=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(d,n).normalize();
    const r=mix(knots[k][3],knots[k+1][3],u-k);
    const depth=mix(knots[k][4]??1,knots[k+1][4]??1,u-k);
    const c=paint(t);
    for(let i=0;i<sides;i++){
      const angle=i*2*Math.PI/sides;
      const v=p.clone().addScaledVector(n,r*Math.cos(angle)).addScaledVector(b,r*depth*Math.sin(angle));
      pos.push(v.x,v.y,v.z);
      rgb.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      if(j<steps){
        const a=j*sides+i,e=j*sides+(i+1)%sides;
        indices.push(a,e,a+sides,e,e+sides,a+sides);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(rgb,3));
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,colors);
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
}

const eyelids=group(head,'eyes');
for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const eye=group(eyelids,side<0?'eye-left':'eye-right',side*.246,.415,.286);
  eye.rotation.y=side*.40;
  eye.rotation.z=side*.10;
  const lid=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,28,18),new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color:side<0?0xc8ac51:0xbca04c,roughness:1
  }));
  lid.scale.set(.108,.058,.026);
  eye.add(lid);
  sweep(eye,'closed eyelid',[
    [-.098,.009,.009,.001],[-.073,-.014,.022,.01],
    [-.016,-.028,.028,.011],[.049,-.022,.023,.009],[.093,.005,.009,.001]
  ],()=>color(0x988342),20,12);
}

const mouth=group(head,'mouth',.011,.170,.357);
sweep(mouth,'small closed smile',[
  [-.201,.018,-.032,.001],[-.143,.002,-.009,.013],
  [-.055,-.008,.004,.017],[.038,-.009,.005,.016],
  [.13,-.003,-.009,.013],[.201,.017,-.033,.001]
],()=>color(0x786d3c),30,12);
sweep(mouth,'lower lip',[
  [-.149,-.009,-.012,.001],[-.076,-.028,.005,.011],
  [.011,-.032,.008,.013],[.092,-.024,.002,.010],[.151,-.009,-.014,.001]
],()=>color(0xc89d4e),24,12);

function makeArm(side){
  const left=side<0;
  const arm=group(character,left?'arm-left':'arm-right',side*.61,4.29,-.09);
  const wristX=left?-.64:.56;
  const wristY=left?-2.10:-2.24;
  sweep(arm,'hanging arm',[
    [0,.18,0,.027],[side*.10,-.03,0,.226],[side*.24,-.42,-.025,.207],
    [side*.32,-.83,-.043,.163],[side*.40,-1.25,-.027,.137],
    [side*.49,-1.67,.005,.111],[wristX,wristY,.09,.083]
  ],t=>highGold.clone().lerp(ochre,sm(t,.25,.84)).lerp(charcoal,sm(t,.80,1)*.91),48,24);
  const hand=group(arm,left?'hand-left':'hand-right',wristX,wristY,.09);
  hand.rotation.z=left?-.35:.40;
  sweep(hand,'palm',[
    [0,.09,0,.066,.75],[0,-.01,.013,.092,.73],
    [.004,-.13,.034,.127,.60],[.006,-.23,.046,.103,.55],[.012,-.279,.049,.006,.8]
  ],t=>charcoal.clone().lerp(fingertip,t*.44),24,22);
  const digits=[
    ['little finger',-.094,.175,-.035],['ring finger',-.034,.268,-.014],
    ['middle finger',.029,.294,.009],['index finger',.093,.237,.042]
  ];
  for(const [name,x,len,spread] of digits){
    const finger=group(hand,name,x*(left?1:-1),-.183,.042);
    const dx=spread*(left?1:-1);
    sweep(finger,'finger',[
      [0,.016,0,.038,.90],[dx*.45,-len*.36,.012,.034,.95],
      [dx,-len*.75,.039,.026,1],[dx*.83,-len*.96,.065,.016,1],
      [dx*.74,-len,.071,.002,1]
    ],t=>charcoal.clone().lerp(fingertip,t*.76),23,14);
  }
  const thumb=group(hand,'thumb',left?.086:-.086,-.075,.039);
  const s=left?1:-1;
  sweep(thumb,'thumb',[
    [0,.014,0,.05],[s*.043,-.066,.023,.041],[s*.066,-.153,.061,.034],
    [s*.061,-.205,.085,.020],[s*.052,-.222,.092,.002]
  ],t=>charcoal.clone().lerp(fingertip,t*.65),24,14);
}
makeArm(-1);
makeArm(1);

function render(t){renderer.render(scene,ref);}
render(0);
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[character],render,ready:true};
</script>
</body>
</html>
